East Basin — public works record and survey extracts
The photograph was supplied without a timestamp or EXIF. The query concerns the tower and brown shed together.
2012-05-08: the brown shed was installed at the marked site.
2017-09-14: the same brown shed was removed; its replacement is white.
An aerial survey before installation and a removal photo agree with those records.
The opaque wall shown on the plan stood in the same position throughout that interval.
Both candidates are at a camera height of about 1.7 m. The wall is 11 m high and the tower is 18 m high. Heights are measured from the same level.
The plan shows candidate points, landmark positions, and the wall. Its coordinates are schematic.
